deviceHeads.sensorEmpty: No filament: the filament sensor is empty
deviceHeads.pickUpText: Pick up {{name}} from its dock? The printer homes X and Y if needed, parks the head on the carriage and moves to {{name}}'s dock.
deviceHeads.parkText: Put {{name}} back in its dock? The carriage moves to the dock.
deviceHeads.autoOff: Automatic loading is off for this feeder on the printer
deviceHeads.pushFirst: Push filament into {{name}}'s side feeder first
deviceHeads.loadText: Load the filament waiting at {{name}}'s feeder? The printer heats the nozzle and moves the head.
deviceHeads.unloadText: Unload {{name}}'s filament? The printer heats the nozzle and moves the head.
deviceHeads.attached: On the carriage: this head prints next
deviceHeads.dockUnknown: Check its dock: the dock sensors disagree. Make sure the head sits in its dock or on the carriage.
deviceHeads.nozzleHelp: Tell the printer which nozzle is fitted after swapping one. The slicer's printer profile should match.
deviceHeads.toolChanges: Tool changes: {{count}} ({{since}} since the docks were last serviced)
deviceHeads.resetText: Mark the docks of all heads as serviced? The printer starts counting tool changes toward its next maintenance reminder again.
deviceHeads.official: This spool was read from a Snapmaker RFID tag, so the printer keeps its details.
